_schema: digitisation_tree.json — the Digitisation tech tree store (DIGITISATION_TREE.md is the authority; this file holds every node). requires = AND over groups, each group satisfied by ANY member. cost = cost_units x RP_PER_UNIT (DIGITISATION_TREE.md § Cost). advantage is the player-facing prose; effects is its machine form (DIGITISATION_TREE.md § Effects): every node carries at least one, and an effect no system reads is kind "unread" naming the system it waits on.
_note: Every advantage, cost and deed is a placeholder to be re-priced in play (Ben, 2026-10-10). Validate with tools/session/tree_lint.js digitisation.
